notes.subject: David Wilks email — 2027 planning
notes.body: On August 28, 2026, David Wilks, Draper City Community Events Manager, replied that planning and logistics for the September 12, 2026 International Arts & Crafts Festival were already finalized, but that they would keep The Adventure Zone in mind while planning for 2027. Current contact: david.wilks@draperutah.gov, 801-576-6584.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: David Wilks explicitly said Draper would keep The Adventure Zone in mind while planning for 2027. Reconnect shortly after the 2026 festival while next year's planning is still early.
